privacyPolicy.title: Privacy & Security
privacyPolicy.intro: NutriFlow ("we", "our", "the app") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: Account information (your email address and sign-in method); profile details you provide (name, sex, age, height, weight, target weight, activity level, dietary preferences and allergies); nutrition activity (meals you log, water intake, weight history, meal plans, and recipes you view or favorite); lab results you choose to upload for AI-powered analysis; step count, if you grant motion permission; and app preferences such as language, dark mode, and notification settings.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use this information to calculate your calorie and macronutrient targets, personalize recipe and meal-plan recommendations, track your progress over time, generate AI nutrition insights from lab results you upload, and remember your app preferences.

sections.heading: Where your data is stored
sections.body: Your profile, meal logs, weight history, and preferences are stored locally on your device. If you sign in with Google or Apple, authentication is handled directly by that provider.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body: We use Google Sign-In and Sign in with Apple as optional authentication methods. Each is governed by its own provider's privacy policy, which we encourage you to review.

sections.heading: Data sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal data, and we do not share your health or nutrition data with third parties, except as necessary to provide the sign-in services you choose to use.

sections.heading: Your rights and choices
sections.body: You can view, edit, or delete your profile and preferences at any time from within the app, and sign out to end your session. Contact us if you would like any data associated with your account removed.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
sections.body: NutriFlow is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from them.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We'll update the "last updated" date above when we do.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or your data, reach us at 5507151kr@gmail.com or via Help & Support in the app.
